topics.name: 1. New Users
topics.announcement: Welcome to YUBIT × Winkey Agent Community New users should complete these steps first: 1. Read the community rules and risk notice. 2. Go to 2. UID Verification and submit your YUBIT UID. 3. Wait for mod confirmation before joining campaigns or trading discussions. Admins will never DM first or ask for passwords, verification codes, private keys, seed phrases, or remote-control access.

topics.name: 2. UID Verification
topics.announcement: UID Verification Please submit your information in this format: UID: your YUBIT UID Source: Winkey Mods will verify whether your UID belongs to the Winkey agent channel. After verification, you can join campaigns, submit feedback, and enter the next operating flow. Do not post phone numbers, emails, IDs, passwords, or verification codes in public.

topics.name: 3. Futures Signals
topics.announcement: Futures Signals This topic is for BTC, ETH, and major futures market observations, key levels, volatility alerts, and risk reminders. All signals are informational only and are not investment advice. Manage your own position size, leverage, and stop loss. No guaranteed returns, paid signal solicitation, or private-call trading.

topics.name: 4. TradFi Signals
topics.announcement: TradFi Signals This topic is for macro, DXY, U.S. yields, gold, oil, major equity indices, and traditional-market signals. Content is for market context only and is not investment advice. Watch volatility and liquidity around high-impact events.

topics.name: 5. Crypto News
topics.announcement: Crypto News This topic is for crypto market news, project updates, regulatory headlines, ETF news, on-chain developments, and exchange-related updates. Use official sources where possible. Avoid rumors, phishing links, and fake announcements.

topics.name: 6. Stocks & TradFi News
topics.announcement: Stocks & TradFi News This topic is for U.S. equities, macro data, FOMC, CPI, NFP, earnings, bonds, FX, and broader traditional-finance news. Market volatility can expand around major data releases. Manage risk carefully.

topics.name: 7. Market Discussion
topics.announcement: Market Discussion Use this topic to discuss market views, trading reviews, risk control, and community analysis. Keep the discussion rational. No personal attacks, spam, ads, group poaching, impersonation, DM solicitation, or guaranteed-profit claims.

topics.name: 8. Campaigns
topics.announcement: Campaigns This topic is for Winkey agent-community campaigns, task rules, leaderboards, reward details, and claim reminders. Eligibility follows official announcements and UID verification results. If rewards are delayed, report it here.
